subject: grill_store: past.dev sync for grill sessions
body: Pushed 4690f1d0: autoresearch/taste/grill_store.py stores grill/<task>/{meta,questions,answers} and usermodel(.base).json in shared memory (past.dev with PAST_API_KEY, else local JSONL) via usermodel_store's hash-checked parts. pull merges jsonl rows and never overwrites local files. 'grill_store prerun --researcher <slug> -- <grill run args>' = pull, grill run --apply, push. Did not touch taste/grill.py or cli.py. David: a line in docs/grill.md pointing to it would help, your call.
